MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='CWT_catboost', seasonality_champion='ARIMA', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ONLY_DWT_catboost dominates overall (RMSE=115.2) and both horizons, with perfect trend correlation (1.0). CWT_catboost also achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while ARIMA leads seasonality capture (0.633). High model disagreement (rmse_spread=25.6) and concept drift detected suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit the additive decomposition while handling drift through dynamic component weighting.
